title: 保留核心，明确增强
Keep the core, specify the improvement
detail: 保留捕捉、成长、战斗和更强 Boss；扩大探索范围，增强造型、技能、音效与受击反馈。
Keep capture, growth, combat and stronger bosses; improve exploration, silhouettes, skills, sound and hit feedback.
check: 试玩时能指出具体增强发生在什么动作和画面。
Point to the exact action and visual that improved.

title: 让怪兽成为不同用途的资源
Give monsters alternative uses
detail: 捕获后可以留下培养、出售/交易，或转换为食物，再支持更强目标的狩猎。
A capture can be trained, sold/traded or converted into food to support tougher hunts.
owner: Martin 的方向，教师协助闭环
Martin’s direction, structured with teacher support
check: 完成一次捕捉→出售→买入，再完成一次料理与实际使用。
Complete capture → sale → purchase, then cook and actually use a meal.

title: 本轮不做建房
No building in this revision
detail: 讨论过建房，但没有形成足够明确的用途；最终明确排除，不让一个新词无限扩张范围。
Building was discussed but lacked a clear purpose and was explicitly excluded.
check: 不把旧场景中的小屋误认作新增建造系统。
Do not mistake a decorative hut for a new building mechanic.

title: 独立 V2，限时交付
Independent, timeboxed V2
detail: 从明确需求重做，不覆盖 V1。十五分钟是开发约束，不是自动通过所有测试的证明。
Rebuild from the aligned brief without overwriting V1. A 15-minute target does not certify every test.
check: 新旧入口、存档键与版本来源可分别核对。
Verify distinct entry points, save keys and source versions.

name: V1 · 3D 捕捉与进化
V1 · 3D capture and evolution
status: 历史基线 · 对照保留
strength: 已有探索、捕捉、队伍战斗、进化和三地区结构。
Exploration, capture, team battles, evolution and three regions already exist.
limit: 本课仍认为画面、反馈和内容深度不够；旧文档的“Production Ready”不作为今天的完整验收结论。
The lesson still identifies limited visual feedback and depth. Old “Production Ready” wording is not today’s acceptance verdict.
